games.name: Animal Attack
games.desc:
Welcome to Animal Attack, a chaotic open-world battleground game where you can play as a human, or experience the world from an animal's perspective.

As an animal, you must survive the humans as they try to catch you while also defending yourself from other animals who may be a hazard.

As a human, you must catch animals with your net, but be careful as some can be dangerous and may fight back! Each catch earns you credits.

There is currently a broad selection of characters in the game ranging from snakes to a wolf, dinosaur and even a giant mech spider, who can be unlocked by collecting in-game credits, completing special quests or purchasing passes for exclusive content!

Again, this is an open-world game with nearly boundless freedom! You can roleplay in this game if you want, just be aware that other players can still attack you.

Brought to you by the creators of Spider Sim!
